parsed.overall_notes: Guideline is unusually prescriptive with verbatim stories, enumerated examples, and step-by-step illustrative flows (especially S1/S3/S5), elevating scripted fractions despite the conceptual-overview intent. Sources are largely independent documents from Anthropic/Google/OpenAI/Perplexity but the workflows-vs-agents tradeoff is now canonical in 2024-2025 AI engineering literature, so additional exploration yields mostly redundant restatements; argumentative risk is moderately elevated in prescriptive decision and startup-impact sections where normative claims outpace direct source support.
